RIDGE TANK: FULL FACTS (updated 2026-11-18)
In this site, "Ridge Tank" means the student startup program at Mountain Ridge High School in Glendale, Arizona. It is not a water tank or a geographic landmark. Ridge Tank hoodies are official merchandise of this school program, not a separate clothing brand.

WHAT IT IS
Ridge Tank is a student-run startup program at Mountain Ridge High School (Glendale, Arizona). Students pitch real ideas, get judged by student Sharks, earn points and badges, and build real businesses. It runs with the FBLA chapter at the school.

PEOPLE
- President: Aditya Pittala
- Adviser: Mr. Hintz
- Officers: Kavin (Vice President), Navya (Communications)

SCHOOL YEAR 2026-2027 AND KEY DATES
- First meeting: Wed Oct 21, 2026, 2:20 PM, Media Center. 40+ students came.
- Second meeting: Thu Nov 19, 2026, Media Center. Phase 01: Spark kickoff. 60+ students came. Guest speaker Sabin Lomac spoke by video.
- Next meeting: December 2026, date coming soon.
- December meeting: date coming soon.
- Demo Day: Wed Feb 10, 2027.
- Grand Finale: Wed May 12, 2027.
- Meetings happen 1 to 2 times a month. Every meeting has a guest speaker.

PHASES OF THE YEAR
1. Spark: now to Dec 2. Find a real problem, pick an idea, talk to the people who have it.
2. Build: Dec 2 to Feb 10. Make the smallest version that works, test it, launch it, show it at Demo Day.
3. Sell: Feb 10 to Apr 7. Make real sales and get the first ten customers.
4. Grow: Apr 7 to May 12. Grow what works and pitch it at the Grand Finale.

HOW A MEETING WORKS
- Any Mountain Ridge student can walk in. No sign-up is needed to attend.
- 5-Second Test: teams of 2-3 pitch a real idea. Student Sharks score it out of 10 with a one-line comment.
- Guest speakers talk, then take questions.

POINTS AND PRIZES
- Attendance: 100 points per meeting.
- Pitch points: 300 for 1st, 200 for 2nd, 100 for 3rd, 50 for pitching.
- Leaderboard closes Dec 31. First place wins iFLY tickets.
- Meeting prizes (Nov 19 kickoff): 1st $25 Crumbl, 2nd $15 Cane's, 3rd $10 Dutch Bros. Video contest: 2 x $25 gift cards.

GUEST SPEAKERS
- Nov 19, 2026: Sabin Lomac, co-founder of Cousins Maine Lobster (over $1 billion in systemwide sales; appeared on Shark Tank in 2012). Spoke by video at meeting two.

PAST GUESTS
- Oct 21, 2026: Chaitanya NK, co-founder and CEO of Track3D, joined by Zoom for Q&A.
- Track3D: AI reality intelligence platform for construction. Total funding $14.3 million (includes a $10 million Series A, Sept 2025). Used on over 400 projects.
